title: The Lake Before the Storm
description: Ferry crossings over a swimmable, bramble-seeded lake: board at the jetty, time the open-water storm lanes from cover, and never miss the last boat. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

identity.scope: Monthly sample route; not a final five-minute day

rooms.name: The first lake jetty
rooms.lesson: Board at the jetty · time the open-water storm from the far shore. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The storm shelter
rooms.lesson: Wait for the warning to clear before crossing. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The storm ferry
rooms.lesson: The ferry climbs · read the storm lane over the strait. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The headland path
rooms.lesson: Cross the headland above the lake. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The exposed landing
rooms.lesson: Use the landing shelters between storm lanes. Follow the weight as it swings away.

rooms.name: The last evening boat
rooms.lesson: The last boat waits for no one · dash the storm gap. Follow the weight as it swings away.
